지시사항: Read docs/api-contract.md for exact API contract details before changing API behavior.
Treat docs/api-contract.md as canonical when code and contract disagree.
Additive API changes must update the docs/api-contract.md change log.
Breaking API changes require team agreement, Slack notice, version update, and change log entry.
Do not silently delete, rename, retype, or change frozen fields, statuses, DOM hooks, or actions.
Do not implement member-dependent APIs until authentication method and userId type are finalized.
Use http://localhost:8080/api as the Spring development API base URL unless instructed otherwise.
Use Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 for API requests and responses.
Use Authorization: Bearer <token> for authenticated APIs after auth is finalized.
Return resources directly on success; do not add unnecessary response envelopes.
Use 201 for create, 200 for read, and 204 for no-content success.
Return errors as {code,message,status}.
Use uppercase snake case error codes with domain prefixes when possible.
Use page, size, and sort query parameters for list pagination.
Use page responses with content, page, size, totalElements, and totalPages.
Use English camelCase JSON keys.
Represent money as integer KRW in price without decimals or currency symbols.
Represent date-time values as ISO 8601 UTC strings.
Use bigint(int8) for domain primary keys unless specified otherwise.
Use only the frozen order status values from docs/api-contract.md.
Use only the frozen payment status values from docs/api-contract.md.
Keep KakaoPay Secret_Key only on the Spring server.
Do not expose payment secrets to frontend code or commits.
Do not use KakaoPay legacy Admin_Key for the documented flow.
Preserve frozen goods fields goodsId, name, price, imageUrl, and tags.
Do not rename or retype goodsId.
Add goods fields only when additive and documented.
Preserve WebSocket endpoint /client-ws.
Preserve client message shape with type text-input and text.
Preserve server message shape with type, text, and actions array.
Keep actions as an array; empty actions are allowed for MVP.
Use [ACTION:actionName key="value"] syntax for AI actions.
Support MVP actions navigate, highlight, and addToCart.
Represent WebSocket actions as JSON objects derived from [ACTION] tags.
Use type plus the documented action field: navigate.path, highlight.selector, or addToCart.goodsId.
Preserve #content as the main content container.
Preserve #vtuber and do not replace it during page transitions.
Preserve data-goods-id, data-artist-id, and data-add-to-cart hooks.
